This '''city''' was the lone major [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] [[Flitter (planet)|Fitter]] during the early portion of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces eventually discovered Flitter's existence and attacked, turning this city into so much rubble.
